reason: Automates rule-gated, one-time approval of selected DeepSeek Harness Shell and PowerShell sandbox escalations, with fixed risk checks, optional LLM review, and human fallback for uncertain requests.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中根据命令规则和可选的 LLM 审查，对符合条件的 Shell 与 PowerShell 沙箱升级请求进行一次性自动批准。
summaries.en: Automates one-time approval of selected Shell and PowerShell sandbox escalations in DeepSeek Harness using command rules, fixed checks, optional LLM review, and human fallback.

capabilities: Evaluates correlated Shell and PowerShell sandbox escalation requests
Automatically grants one-time approval for requests matching configured command-prefix rules
Optionally sends bounded approval context to a configured LLM reviewer
Provides loopback settings configuration through the Harness settings service
